description: EF-comment coverage taxonomy for DOCX-extracted and comparison-PDF comments. Each row represents one reviewer comment classified against the auditor's structural rule taxonomy. comment_id is a deterministic 12-char SHA-256 prefix of (doc_alias, comment_category, ordinal). No raw reviewer text, student names, private file paths, or dissertation body text is stored.

taxonomy_classes.SIM: Structural In-scope Matched — auditor has a matching rule that fires on the same structural category; finding is captured in default or opt-in mode.
taxonomy_classes.SIP: Structural In-scope Partial — auditor has a rule for the structural category but exact page-level or instance-level match cannot be confirmed; detection may be partial or context-dependent.
taxonomy_classes.SMI: Structural Missing Implementation — structural formatting category within scope of the heuristic auditor, but no current rule is implemented to detect this specific pattern.
taxonomy_classes.SBL: Structural Blocked — structural category is in scope but technically blocked: semantic content detection, image-embedded pages, or cross-entry comparison logic would be required.
taxonomy_classes.SEM: Semantic/Editorial — semantic, grammatical, or editorial content issue; outside the scope of a structural layout auditor.
taxonomy_classes.PRF: Preference/Style — reviewer formatting preference not backed by a verifiable NJIT guideline requirement.
taxonomy_classes.AMB: Ambiguous — insufficient information to classify; comment may apply to multiple categories or intent is unclear from available metadata.

doc_aliases.DOCX_3RD_A: Third-review DOCX file A — 22 EF comments extracted via P080 DOCX extractor; category breakdown from docs/evaluation/post_p080_docx_pdf_overlap_evaluation.md.
doc_aliases.DOCX_3RD_B: Third-review DOCX file B — 30 EF comments extracted via P080 DOCX extractor; category breakdown from docs/evaluation/post_p080_docx_pdf_overlap_evaluation.md.
